title: Fresh Qwen change candidate and apply-request dogfood
objective: Run one fresh qwen3-builder scratch-only change from exact current HEAD, independently verify it, materialize a fresh verified change candidate, and admit its apply request without applying it.
laws: Worker runs only in a disposable Legion worktree at the exact canonical base SHA.
T590 independently verifies exact content and no out-of-scope mutations.
Verified candidate baseSha must equal the current canonical target SHA.
Trust Canal may admit MISSION_CHANGE_APPLY_REQUEST only after freshness proof.
No canonical apply occurs in this mission.
